proofs.passage: At the end of your turn, one card  must  be discarded from your hand and placed on top of the discard pile face up. If you began your turn by picking up the top card of the discard pile you are not allowed to end that turn by discarding the same card, leaving the pile unchanged - you must discard a different card. You may however pick up the discard on one turn and discard that same card at a later turn. If you draw a card from the stock, it can be discarded on the same turn if you wish.

proofs.passage: A player wins an individual hand by either melding, laying off, or discarding all of his or her cards. Getting rid of your last card in one of these ways is called  going out . As soon as someone goes out, play ceases. There can be no further melding or laying off, even if the other players have valid combinations in their hands.

proofs.passage: You  must  begin by taking one card from either the top of the Stock pile or the top card on the discard pile, and adding it to your hand. The discard pile is face up, so you can see in advance what you are getting. The stock is face down, so if you choose to draw from the stock you do not see the card until after you have committed yourself to take it. If you draw from the stock, you add the card to your hand without showing it to the other players.

3.2.2 The dealer must thoroughly sh uffle the cards. The player to his right must then cut the 
deck one time. The cards are then dealt from the top. 
 
3.2.3  If the cards are shuffled in a riffling (North American) manner , they must be shuffled one 
more time in the overhand (German) manner before being cut. 
 
3.2.4 Cutting the cards is mandatory.  A minimum of four cards must either be lifted up or left 
on the table. 
 
3.2.5 If a playing partner at a table with more than three play ing partners is temporarily absent, 
the playing partner to his immediate right may cut the cards un less the absentee has 
expressly reserved his right to do so.  If there is an extended  absence, a referee 
determines how to proceed. 
 
3.2.6 Beginning with the playin g partner to the left of the dea l e r ,  t h e  c a r d s  a r e  d e a l t  i n  t h e  
following manner. One round of three cards to each player.  Two cards as the skat.  Then 
four cards to each player and finally three cards to each player.

cards.editorialAnalysis: Easy: знакомое название распределения карт. Дистракторы — три соседние операции; ни один не равнозначен раздаче. Справка правильного варианта добавляет 26 карт в Войне. Оговорка rummy выхода исправлена; источник War непосредственно демонстрирует распределение.

actualLiteral: Как называется распределение карт участникам в начале игры?
fields.claimAnalysis: The Deal распределяет по 26 карт двум участникам; русское название раздача — точный терминологический перевод распределения dealt.

fields.actualLiteral: В базовом рамми игрок начинает ход добором из запаса или открытого сброса.
fields.claimAnalysis: Начало хода — одна карта stock/discard, а не исходная раздача; обе доступные стопки названы.

proofs.sourceClass: original rules authored by primary rule publisher
proofs.title: Pagat — Basic Rummy
proofs.captureMethod: full curl HTTP response; see fetch receipts
proofs.passage: You  must  begin by taking one card from either the top of the Stock pile or the top card on the discard pile, and adding it to your hand. The discard pile is face up, so you can see in advance what you are getting. The stock is face down, so if you choose to draw from the stock you do not see the card until after you have committed yourself to take it. If you draw from the stock, you add the card to your hand without showing it to the other players.

fields.actualLiteral: В базовом рамми обычный ход заканчивается открытым сбросом; выход возможен и выкладыванием или подкладыванием последней карты.
fields.claimAnalysis: Открытый сброс завершает обычный ход. Выход может быть выкладыванием либо подкладыванием последней карты, поэтому «каждый» снято.

proofs.sourceClass: original rules authored by primary rule publisher
proofs.title: Pagat — Basic Rummy
proofs.captureMethod: full curl HTTP response; see fetch receipts
proofs.passage: At the end of your turn, one card  must  be discarded from your hand and placed on top of the discard pile face up. If you began your turn by picking up the top card of the discard pile you are not allowed to end that turn by discarding the same card, leaving the pile unchanged - you must discard a different card. You may however pick up the discard on one turn and discard that same card at a later turn. If you draw a card from the stock, it can be discarded on the same turn if you wish.

proofs.passage: A player wins an individual hand by either melding, laying off, or discarding all of his or her cards. Getting rid of your last card in one of these ways is called  going out . As soon as someone goes out, play ceases. There can be no further melding or laying off, even if the other players have valid combinations in their hands.

fields.actualLiteral: Раздача распределяет карты между участниками перед началом игры или сдачи. Правила игры задают число карт и порядок, в котором их выдают.
fields.claimAnalysis: War выдаёт по одной, Skat пакетами 3,4,3; вместе подтверждают, что число и способ выдачи определяет конкретная игра. Раздача precedes play по структуре обоих правил.
